thread:
maria: Heads up — I'm starting canary bring-up for rwd-llama-13b-v3-candidate in hosted. Need quick agreement on smoke tests + SLA guardrails before we widen traffic. Proposed plan below.

arjun: thanks — share the proposed thresholds pls.

maria: TL;DR: start 1% traffic for 2 hours, if all gates pass bump to 5% for 4 hours, then 20% for 24h, then gradual. Gates: (1) automated quality delta vs prod <= -1.5% on eval-suite accuracy (2) human disagreement rate change <= +2% (3) latency p95 <= prod p95 + 80ms (4) error rate < 0.5% and < prod error_rate + 0.2%. If any gate fails -> immediate fallback to rwd-llama-13b-v2.

ashley: +1 to human disagreement guardrail. How are we computing eval-suite accuracy?

maria: eval-suite is composite: 60% question-answer accuracy (exact match), 30% code-gen correctness (unit-check pass@1), 10% safety filters pass-rate. We compute weighted score. Baseline prod score is 0.832. So minimum allowed is 0.816 (i.e. -1.5% relative).

kevin: what about prompt-length distribution? v3 has a slightly longer tail. We should gate on tail latency separately. Maybe add >95th percentile tokens latency delta cap.

maria: good call. Add p99 latency delta cap = +200ms.

carla: what about quantized variants? This candidate is int8-quant-infer. Need to ensure no compression regressions. Suggest a small regression budget on token-level perplexity: <= +3% vs prod.

arjun: ok. Also recommend adding soft gates vs hard gates for small deltas — e.g., if eval delta is between -1.5% and -3% then keep canary paused and trigger human review, not immediate rollback. Anything worse -> rollback.

maria: agreed. Plan: hard rollback if eval delta <= -3% or human disagreement >= +5% or error rate >= 1.0% or p95 latency >= +200ms. Soft pause zone if delta between -1.5% and -3%.

ashley: can we codify this in canary config so deploy-bot can enforce?

maria: drafted config snippet: 
```yaml
canary:
  initial_traffic: 0.01
  stages:
    - pct: 1
      duration: 120m
    - pct: 5
      duration: 240m
    - pct: 20
      duration: 1440m
gates:
  eval_accuracy_relative_threshold: -0.015  # hard lower bound only triggers rollback if <= -0.03
  eval_accuracy_soft_lower: -0.03
  human_disagreement_hard: 0.05
  human_disagreement_soft: 0.02
  latency_p95_delta_ms_hard: 200
  latency_p95_delta_ms_soft: 80
  error_rate_hard: 0.01
  error_rate_soft: 0.005
fallback_model: rwd-llama-13b-v2
automation:
  on_hard_failure: rollback
  on_soft_failure: pause_and_notify
```

kevin: looks good. who will own the smoke run? we need an SRE + ML lead on-call.

maria: I'll own the smoke and coordinate with eng-infra. @carla to run the eval harness and post results every 30m. @arjun you'll coordinate human eval panel?

carla: yes. I'll kick off the harness now against latest quant build. Expect first report in ~25m.

infra-bot: deploy-bot triggered canary: rwd-llama-13b-v3-candidate -> initial 1% on hosted-us-west1 at 1773008190.

deploy-bot: canary-stage: 1% started. Monitoring metrics: eval_harness, latency_p95, error_rate, human_disagreement_polling. Alerts configured for soft/hard thresholds.

arjun: human eval crowd scheduled for a rolling 2-hour window, will send batch1 at 1773008400. Please flag any ambiguous examples.

carla: eval harness pass1: weighted_eval_score=0.830 (-0.24% relative to prod), detail: qa_em=0.838, code_pass=0.792, safety_pass=0.995. p95_latency=210ms (+70ms), p99_latency=410ms (+140ms), error_rate=0.002.

maria: nice — within soft thresholds and above hard rollback. keep monitoring. will not widen until we have 4h at 1% showing stable.

kevin: token-perplexity delta = +1.9% (within quant budget). Good.

ashley: human disagreement sample1: +1.8% delta vs prod. within soft. no obvious safety regressions in sample.

carla: eval harness pass2 (after 60m): weighted_eval_score=0.827 (-0.6%), p95=230ms (+90ms), p99=450ms (+180ms), error_rate=0.003. note p95 creeping toward soft limit but still under p95_hard.

maria: thanks. based on the glide path I'd say we can move to 5% after 2h if next check at 2h still in soft zone. Any objections?

arjun: +1. Let's proceed but keep human panel on double-check.

kevin: one caveat: longer-tail requests (context > 4k tokens) show p99 spikes > 600ms. We should add routing rule to avoid sending long-context to canary until v3 is mitigated.

maria: adding short-context-only routing for canary: max_tokens_context=4096. I'll push rule to TrafficRouter.

deploy-bot: traffic-rule update applied: canary only receives requests with context_tokens <= 4096.

infra-bot: reminder: if any hard gate triggers, we'll auto rollback and create a rollback ticket.

maria: thanks team. next scheduled checkpoint in 60m. will drop updates here.
